round: # UNDERSTAND. One dialogue or short spoken story per unit with the unit's new language. The first page explains the pattern in Dari (intro_fa).
# Two questions each; the right choice is not always first. Two voices: f = woman or girl

intro_fa: دو شاگرد از کار پدر و مادر خود گپ می‌زنند. برای کار می‌پرسیم What does he do یعنی «او چه کار می‌کند». جواب: He is a farmer. پیش از نام کار a می‌آید.
say_en: f: What does your father do? // m: He is a farmer. He works in the field.
show_en: What does your father do? He is a farmer. He works in the field.

say_en: What does his father do?
show_en: What does his father do?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت He is a farmer: پدرش دهقان است.

say_en: m: And your mother? What does she do? // f: She is a baker. She makes bread.
show_en: And your mother? What does she do? She is a baker. She makes bread.

say_en: f: My brother is a driver. He drives a lorry.
show_en: My brother is a driver. He drives a lorry.

say_en: Who is the baker?
show_en: Who is the baker?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت She is a baker: مادرش نانوا است.

say_en: m: What is your uncle's job? // f: He is a carpenter. He makes doors and tables.
show_en: What is your uncle's job? He is a carpenter. He makes doors and tables.

intro_fa: وقتی از he یا she گپ می‌زنیم، به فعل s می‌چسبد: I make، اما he makes. A baker makes bread. گوش کن که هر کس در کار خود چه می‌کند.
say_en: f: My mother is a weaver. She makes carpets. // m: Are they beautiful?
show_en: My mother is a weaver. She makes carpets. Are they beautiful?

say_en: f: Yes, they are. She sells them in the bazaar.
show_en: Yes, they are. She sells them in the bazaar.

say_en: What does a weaver make?
show_en: What does a weaver make?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت She makes carpets: قالین‌باف قالین می‌بافد.

say_en: m: My brother is a mechanic. He repairs cars.
show_en: My brother is a mechanic. He repairs cars.

say_en: f: And my aunt is an engineer. She builds bridges.
show_en: And my aunt is an engineer. She builds bridges.

say_en: Who repairs cars?
show_en: Who repairs cars?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت My brother is a mechanic. He repairs cars: مستری موترها را ترمیم می‌کند.

intro_fa: برای جای کار می‌پرسیم Where does she work یعنی «او کجا کار می‌کند». جواب: She works in a clinic. برای افزار کار with می‌گوییم: He works with a saw.
say_en: m: Where does your mother work? // f: She works in a clinic. She is a nurse.
show_en: Where does your mother work? She works in a clinic. She is a nurse.

say_en: Where does her mother work?
show_en: Where does her mother work?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت She works in a clinic: مادرش در کلینیک کار می‌کند.

say_en: f: And your father? // m: He is a carpenter. He works with a saw and a hammer.
show_en: And your father? He is a carpenter. He works with a saw and a hammer.

say_en: What does the carpenter work with?
show_en: What does the carpenter work with?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت He works with a saw and a hammer: نجار با اره و چکش کار می‌کند.

say_en: f: My uncle works in the field. He drives a tractor. // m: A tractor! I like tractors.
show_en: My uncle works in the field. He drives a tractor. A tractor! I like tractors.

intro_fa: I want to be یعنی «می‌خواهم ... شوم». با آن از آرزوی خود برای آینده گپ می‌زنیم: I want to be a teacher.
say_en: f: What do you want to be, Omar? // m: I want to be a teacher.
show_en: What do you want to be, Omar? I want to be a teacher.

say_en: m: I like children and I like books. // f: That is good!
show_en: I like children and I like books. That is good!

say_en: What does Omar want to be?
show_en: What does Omar want to be?
wrong_say_fa: نه. عمر گفت I want to be a teacher: می‌خواهد معلم شود.

say_en: m: And you, Roya? // f: When I grow up, I want to be an engineer.
show_en: And you, Roya? When I grow up, I want to be an engineer.

say_en: f: I want to build bridges and roads.
show_en: I want to build bridges and roads.

say_en: What does Roya want to build?
show_en: What does Roya want to build?
wrong_say_fa: نه. رویا گفت I want to build bridges and roads: می‌خواهد پل و سرک بسازد.

say_en: m: Then you must learn a lot. // f: Yes. I learn every day.
show_en: Then you must learn a lot. Yes. I learn every day.

intro_fa: برای پلان‌های آینده می‌گوییم going to. اول am، is یا are می‌آید، بعد going to، بعد فعل ساده: I am going to visit. He is going to buy. We are going to play.
say_en: f: Tomorrow is Friday. What are you going to do? // m: I am going to visit my aunt.
show_en: Tomorrow is Friday. What are you going to do? I am going to visit my aunt.

say_en: m: We are going to go by bus.
show_en: We are going to go by bus.

say_en: Who is he going to visit?
show_en: Who is he going to visit?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت I am going to visit my aunt: به دیدن خاله‌اش می‌رود.

say_en: f: I am going to go to the bazaar with my mother. She is going to buy shoes.
show_en: I am going to go to the bazaar with my mother. She is going to buy shoes.

say_en: What is her mother going to buy?
show_en: What is her mother going to buy?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت She is going to buy shoes: مادرش بوت می‌خرد.

say_en: m: Look at the sky. It is going to rain. // f: Then I am going to take an umbrella.
show_en: Look at the sky. It is going to rain. Then I am going to take an umbrella.

intro_fa: سوال از پلان: Are you going to come? جواب کوتاه: Yes, I am یا No, I'm not. برای «نه» not را پیش از going می‌آوریم: She is not going to cook.
say_en: f: Are you going to come to my house today? // m: Yes, I am.
show_en: Are you going to come to my house today? Yes, I am.

say_en: f: Are you going to bring your ball? // m: No, I'm not. I am going to bring my kite.
show_en: Are you going to bring your ball? No, I'm not. I am going to bring my kite.

say_en: What is he going to bring?
show_en: What is he going to bring?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت I am going to bring my kite: کاغذپران خود را می‌آورد، نه توپ را.

say_en: f: Is your sister going to come? // m: No, she isn't. She is going to help mother.
show_en: Is your sister going to come? No, she isn't. She is going to help mother.

say_en: Is his sister going to come?
show_en: Is his sister going to come?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت No, she isn't: خواهرش نمی‌آید. او به مادر کمک می‌کند.

say_en: m: Mother is not going to cook today. My sister is going to cook.
show_en: Mother is not going to cook today. My sister is going to cook.

intro_fa: با by می‌گوییم که با چه می‌رویم: by bus، by car. اما پیاده on foot است. گوش کن که حمید چطور به کابل می‌رود.
say_en: m: A ticket to Kabul, please. // f: Here you are. It is two hundred afghani.
show_en: A ticket to Kabul, please. Here you are. It is two hundred afghani.

say_en: What does Hamid buy?
show_en: What does Hamid buy?
wrong_say_fa: نه. حمید گفت A ticket to Kabul, please: او یک تکت می‌خرد.

say_en: m: When is the bus going to go? // f: At nine o'clock.
show_en: When is the bus going to go? At nine o'clock.

say_en: f: Why don't you go by car? // m: A car is expensive. The bus is cheap.
show_en: Why don't you go by car? A car is expensive. The bus is cheap.

say_en: How is Hamid going to go to Kabul?
show_en: How is Hamid going to go to Kabul?
wrong_say_fa: نه. موتر گران است. حمید با بس می‌رود: by bus.

say_en: f: And how do you get to the bus? // m: On foot. It is near.
show_en: And how do you get to the bus? On foot. It is near.

intro_fa: There is برای یک چیز است و There are برای چند چیز: There is a lake. There are mountains. معلم و شاگرد به نقشه نگاه می‌کنند.
say_en: f: Look at the map. This is the world. // m: Where is our country?
show_en: Look at the map. This is the world. Where is our country?

say_en: f: Here. Afghanistan is a country. Kabul is a big city.
show_en: Here. Afghanistan is a country. Kabul is a big city.

say_en: What is Kabul?
show_en: What is Kabul?
wrong_say_fa: نه. معلم گفت Kabul is a big city: کابل یک شهر کلان است. افغانستان کشور است.

say_en: m: Are there mountains in our country? // f: Yes, there are high mountains.
show_en: Are there mountains in our country? Yes, there are high mountains.

say_en: m: Is there a sea? // f: No, there isn't. But there are rivers and lakes.
show_en: Is there a sea? No, there isn't. But there are rivers and lakes.

say_en: Which one is not in Afghanistan?
show_en: Which one is not in Afghanistan?
wrong_say_fa: نه. معلم گفت که در افغانستان بحر نیست. کوه و دریا است.

intro_fa: برای مقایسهٔ دو چیز به آخر صفت er می‌آید و بعد than: big، bigger than. fast، faster than. than یعنی «از».
say_en: m: My horse is bigger than your donkey. // f: Yes, but my donkey is stronger.
show_en: My horse is bigger than your donkey. Yes, but my donkey is stronger.

say_en: f: It can carry more firewood.
show_en: It can carry more firewood.

say_en: Which animal is bigger?
show_en: Which animal is bigger?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت My horse is bigger than your donkey: اسپ از خر کلانتر است.

say_en: m: Is a horse faster than a rabbit? // f: I don't know! A rabbit is very fast.
show_en: Is a horse faster than a rabbit? I don't know! A rabbit is very fast.

say_en: f: But a rabbit is faster than a tortoise. // m: Of course! A tortoise is slower than me.
show_en: But a rabbit is faster than a tortoise. Of course! A tortoise is slower than me.

say_en: Which animal is slower?
show_en: Which animal is slower?
wrong_say_fa: نه. خرگوش از سنگ‌پشت تیزتر است، پس سنگ‌پشت آهسته‌تر است: slower.

intro_fa: صفت‌های دراز er نمی‌گیرند. پیش از آنها more می‌آید: more expensive، more beautiful. دو صفت شکل خاص دارد: good، better و bad، worse.
say_en: f: Look at this red scarf. It is more beautiful than the blue scarf. // m: Yes, but it is more expensive.
show_en: The red scarf is more beautiful, but it is more expensive.

say_en: m: The blue scarf is cheaper.
show_en: The blue scarf is cheaper.

say_en: Which scarf is more expensive?
show_en: Which scarf is more expensive?
wrong_say_fa: نه. چادر سرخ مقبول‌تر است و گرانتر هم است: more expensive.

say_en: f: I need shoes, too. My old shoes are bad. // m: These new shoes are better.
show_en: I need shoes, too. My old shoes are bad. These new shoes are better.

say_en: f: Yes, they are better than my old shoes. And they are not heavy.
show_en: Yes, they are better than my old shoes. And they are not heavy.

say_en: Which shoes are better?
show_en: Which shoes are better?
wrong_say_fa: نه. بوت‌های نو بهتر است: These new shoes are better.

intro_fa: Why یعنی «چرا» و because یعنی «چون». جواب Why با Because شروع می‌شود. گوش کن که چرا خواهر خُرد ترسیده است.
say_en: m: Why are you afraid, little sister? // f: Because it is dark.
show_en: Why are you afraid, little sister? Because it is dark.

say_en: m: Don't be afraid. Here is the lamp. // f: Thank you. Now I am calm.
show_en: Don't be afraid. Here is the lamp. Thank you. Now I am calm.

say_en: Why was she afraid?
show_en: Why was she afraid?
choices: t:It was cold|t:It was dark|t:It was late
wrong_say_fa: نه. او گفت Because it is dark: چون تاریک است.

say_en: f: Why is mother worried? // m: Because father is late.
show_en: Why is mother worried? Because father is late.

say_en: m: Listen! Father is at the door. // f: Now mother is happy!
show_en: Listen! Father is at the door. Now mother is happy!

say_en: Who was late?
show_en: Who was late?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مادر پریشان بود چون پدر ناوقت کرده بود: Father is late.

intro_fa: با because دو جمله را یکجا می‌کنیم: اول کار یا آرزو، بعد دلیل. I want to be a doctor because I want to help.
say_en: f: I want to be a doctor because I want to help sick people. // m: That is a good job.
show_en: I want to be a doctor because I want to help sick people.

say_en: m: I want to be a farmer because I like animals and fields.
show_en: I want to be a farmer because I like animals and fields.

say_en: Why does the boy want to be a farmer?
show_en: Why does the boy want to be a farmer?
choices: t:He likes cars|t:He likes animals|t:He is strong
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت because I like animals and fields: چون حیوان‌ها و زمین‌ها را خوش دارد.

say_en: f: Tomorrow I am going to go to the city. I am going to take an umbrella. // m: Why?
show_en: I am going to take an umbrella.

say_en: f: Because it is going to rain.
show_en: Because it is going to rain.

say_en: What is she going to take?
show_en: What is she going to take?
wrong_say_fa: نه. او چتری می‌گیرد چون باران خواهد بارید.

intro_fa: قصه با One day شروع می‌شود. بعد Then می‌آید. برای چیزی که یکدم می‌شود Suddenly می‌گوییم. و در آخر Finally یا In the end.
say_en: f: One day I went to the field with our sheep. // m: And then?
show_en: One day I went to the field with our sheep. And then?

say_en: f: Then I sat under a tree. Suddenly I saw a wolf!
show_en: Then I sat under a tree. Suddenly I saw a wolf!

say_en: What did she see?
show_en: What did she see?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت Suddenly I saw a wolf: ناگهان یک گرگ دید.

say_en: m: What did you do? // f: I shouted. My father and the dog came.
show_en: What did you do? I shouted. My father and the dog came.

say_en: f: Finally the wolf ran away. In the end all the sheep were safe.
show_en: Finally the wolf ran away. In the end all the sheep were safe.

say_en: Were the sheep safe in the end?
show_en: Were the sheep safe in the end?
wrong_say_fa: بلی، بودند. دختر گفت In the end all the sheep were safe.

intro_fa: در قصه می‌گوییم که کی چه گفت: said یعنی گفت، asked یعنی پرسید، answered یعنی جواب داد. گوش کن که روباه و زاغ چه گفتند.
say_en: f: One day a crow had some cheese. A fox saw it.
show_en: One day a crow had some cheese. A fox saw it.

say_en: f: "Good morning," said the fox. "You are a beautiful bird."
show_en: "Good morning," said the fox. "You are a beautiful bird."

say_en: f: "Can you sing?" asked the fox.
show_en: "Can you sing?" asked the fox.

say_en: Who asked: Can you sing?
show_en: Who asked: Can you sing?
wrong_say_fa: نه. روباه پرسید: asked the fox.

say_en: f: The crow opened its mouth and sang. The cheese fell down.
show_en: The crow opened its mouth and sang. The cheese fell down.

say_en: f: "Thank you!" said the fox, and it ate the cheese.
show_en: "Thank you!" said the fox, and it ate the cheese.

say_en: What did the fox eat?
show_en: What did the fox eat?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پنیر از دهان زاغ افتاد و روباه آن را خورد.

intro_fa: یک قصهٔ قدیمی از شیر و موش. clever یعنی هوشیار، brave یعنی دلیر، strong یعنی قوی. گوش کن که کی به کی کمک می‌کند.
say_en: m: One day a lion caught a little mouse. "Please let me go," said the mouse. "One day I am going to help you."
show_en: "Please let me go," said the mouse.

say_en: m: The lion laughed. "You are too small," he said. But he let the mouse go.
show_en: The lion laughed. "You are too small," he said. But he let the mouse go.

say_en: Did the lion eat the mouse?
show_en: Did the lion eat the mouse?
wrong_say_fa: نه. شیر خندید و موش را رها کرد: He let the mouse go.

say_en: m: Later the lion was in a net. He could not get out. He shouted.
show_en: Later the lion was in a net. He could not get out. He shouted.

say_en: m: The mouse came. It bit the net with its teeth. The lion was free!
show_en: The mouse came. It bit the net with its teeth. The lion was free!

say_en: Who helped the lion?
show_en: Who helped the lion?
wrong_say_fa: نه. موش جال را با دندان‌هایش برید و شیر آزاد شد.

say_en: m: "Thank you," said the lion. "You are small, but you are brave and clever."
show_en: "Thank you," said the lion. "You are small, but you are brave and clever."

intro_fa: یک پیام کوتاه سه حصه دارد: اول Dear و نام، بعد گپ اصلی، و در آخر From و نام خودت. گوش کن که مینا چه نوشته است.
say_en: m: Look, a letter for you, Sara. // f: Who is it from?
show_en: Look, a letter for you, Sara. Who is it from?

say_en: m: It is from Mina. I read it: Dear Sara, how are you? I am fine.
show_en: It is from Mina. I read it: Dear Sara, how are you? I am fine.

say_en: Who is the letter from?
show_en: Who is the letter from?
wrong_say_fa: نه. خط از طرف مینا است: It is from Mina. سارا آن را می‌گیرد.

say_en: m: I am going to come on Friday. See you soon. From Mina.
show_en: I am going to come on Friday. See you soon. From Mina.

say_en: When is Mina going to come?
show_en: When is Mina going to come?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مینا نوشت I am going to come on Friday: روز جمعه می‌آید.

say_en: f: Mina is going to come! I am going to write a message to her, too.
show_en: Mina is going to come! I am going to write a message to her, too.

intro_fa: سه قسم پیام کوتاه: دعوت با Please come، تشکر با Thank you for، و معذرت با I am sorry. دلیل را با because می‌گوییم.
say_en: f: Hamid, please come to my house on Friday. We are going to eat together. // m: Thank you, Laila!
show_en: Please come to my house on Friday.

say_en: m: Oh no. I am sorry, I can't come because I am sick.
show_en: Oh no. I am sorry, I can't come because I am sick.

say_en: Why can't Hamid come?
show_en: Why can't Hamid come?
choices: t:He is late|t:It is far|t:He is sick
wrong_say_fa: نه. حمید گفت I can't come because I am sick: چون مریض است.

say_en: f: Get well soon! Here is a present for you. // m: Thank you for the present.
show_en: Get well soon! Here is a present for you. Thank you for the present.

say_en: What does Laila give Hamid?
show_en: What does Laila give Hamid?
wrong_say_fa: نه. لیلا گفت Here is a present for you: یک تحفه.

say_en: m: I am going to come next week. // f: Good. See you soon!
show_en: I am going to come next week. Good. See you soon!

intro_fa: دو دوست از آیندهٔ خود گپ می‌زنند: چه می‌خواهند شوند، کجا درس می‌خوانند و چرا. going to و because را با هم می‌شنوی.
say_en: f: In the future I am going to study at the university. // m: Why?
show_en: In the future I am going to study at the university. Why?

say_en: f: Because I want to be a doctor. Our village needs a doctor.
show_en: Because I want to be a doctor. Our village needs a doctor.

say_en: What does the village need?
show_en: What does the village need?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت Our village needs a doctor: قریهٔ ما به داکتر ضرورت دارد.

say_en: m: I am going to be a teacher. I am going to teach in our school.
show_en: I am going to be a teacher. I am going to teach in our school.

say_en: Where is he going to teach?
show_en: Where is he going to teach?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پسر گفت I am going to teach in our school: در مکتب قریه درس می‌دهد.

say_en: f: Then we are going to help our village together. // m: Yes!
show_en: Then we are going to help our village together. Yes!
